text: Bitcoin's modest 1.3% pullback sits within normal range while Ethereum's resilience at -0.4% suggests selective strength in the second-largest asset, with the broader altcoin weakness (BNB and SOL both down 2.4%) pointing to profit-taking rather than panic. The Fear & Greed index at 69 with a rising 7-day trend indicates sustained optimism, though Bitcoin's 58.5% dominance near recent highs shows capital concentrating in the largest names during this consolidation. Volume at $92B remains healthy enough to support current price levels without obvious exhaustion or capitulation.
